Stops a timer from ticking and posting events until [ResumeTimer](ResumeTimer) is called. Its tick count stays where it is.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Timer", 20, 20, 240, 100, Desktop(), 3)
tm = CreateTimer(2)
PauseTimer tm
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent(1000)
	If e = $4001 Then SetGadgetText win, "Never gets here"
Until e = $803
```
@param timer  A timer from `CreateTimer`.
